in_sanskrit.name: नन्ह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit root 'nan' means 'young' or 'new'. The suffix 'h' is used to denote the diminutive form, making it 'little' or 'young one'. This name is not commonly used in Sanskrit, but it is a cognate and has the same meaning.

in_hindi.name: नन्हे
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name 'Nanhe' is a pet name for 'Nan' (grandfather). It is derived from the Hindi words 'chhota' (small), 'bachcha' (child), and 'beta' (son). It is used to denote a young or little one, and it is a common name in the Hindi language.

in_tamil.name: நன்குடி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name 'Nan-kudi' translates to 'small one' or 'young one'. The name is derived from the Tamil word 'nan' (small) and the suffix '-kudi' (one). It is used to denote a young or little one in the Tamil language.

in_telugu.name: నన్నే
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name 'Nanna' or 'Nan-ne' translates to 'my father' or 'grandfather'. It is a diminutive form of 'Nan' and is used as a term of endearment for a young or little one. The suffix '-ne' is used to denote the diminutive form. The name 'Nan-ne' can also be translated to 'little one' or 'my dear one' in the Telugu language.

in_marathi.name: Nanhe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nanhe हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nanhe is derived from the Hindi and Sanskrit words ‘nan’ which means small and ‘he’ which means ‘he’. The name is used as a term of endearment for a young boy.
